question: In which simple multi-cellular organism does sporangia develop on hyphae and spore formation occurs in sporangia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rhizopus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rhizopus** is a genus of common fungi.
 
• It is also known as **black bread mold** due to its appearance and growth on bread.
 
• **Sporangia** are structures that develop on the hyphae of Rhizopus.
 
• **Spore formation** occurs within these sporangia.
 
• These spores are then released to reproduce and spread the fungus.
 
• Rhizopus species are important in industrial and food processing applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Leishmania**__

 __
 
• **Leishmania** is a genus of protozoan parasites.
 
• It is responsible for the disease **leishmaniasis**, which is transmitted by the bite of infected sandflies.
 
• Leishmaniasis affects various parts of the body, including the skin and internal organs.
 
 
 
• **Yeast**__
 __
 
• **Yeasts** are single-celled fungi.
 
• They are used in baking, brewing, and winemaking due to their ability to ferment sugars.
 
• The most common type of yeast is **Saccharomyces cerevisiae**.
 
 
 
• **Amoeba**__
 
 
• **Amoeba** is a type of single-celled organism.
 
• It moves and feeds using **pseudopodia**, which are temporary projections of its cell body.
 
• Amoebas are found in various water bodies and moist environments.
